purpose: Shared orientation, continuity, focus, singular Decision Frame, four-ledger, affordance, recommendation, uncertainty, coverage, budget, continuation, and handoff spine for every agent-facing result.

pilot.intent: Immediate manual-capture guidance tied to evidence deficits.

forensic.intent: Evidence-complete audit or reconciliation for bounded scope.

custom.intent: Explicit registered projection union under hard bounds.

required_invariants.statement: Every success, progress record, and error carries the same agent-turn spine.
Every packet binds one compatible anchor vector and immutable generation of each included projection.
Continuity gaps, resets, staleness, and indeterminate outcomes are explicit.
Only observed and eligible certified-derived facts may satisfy authoritative preconditions.
Active work and the minimum safe next protocol step remain visible across errors and handoffs.
Recommendations are structured, costed, evidence-linked, authority-free, and may recommend doing nothing.
Empty results never prove absence without complete-domain coverage and detectability.
Budget exhaustion returns a complete decision-useful prefix, omissions, and continuation without dropping safety.
Memory, text, attention, and counterfactuals cannot grant capability or dispatch effects.
Equivalent packets use registered canonical ordering and tie breaks.
Prediction-observation divergence creates an explicit surprise record.
A handoff packet is sufficient to resume safely without reconstructing the transcript.
Turn identity and authority-bearing request identity are distinct and never silently aliased.
All subsystem state is projected through the same abstraction tower and four ledgers.
A question names the evidence and stopping rule required for resolution.
A context pack exposes Pack DNA for inclusion, omission, and marginal budget value.
Every materially decision-bearing packet contains exactly one compatible Decision Frame.
Attention re-interrupts only after a material transition, expiry, or invalidated acknowledgement.
Every public spatial reference is frame-complete and historically resolvable.
Pilot recommendation, acknowledgement, observed maneuver, usable evidence, and question resolution remain separate facts.
Every public machine surface uses one registry-derived lower snake_case vocabulary and fdgr.<name>/1 payload identity.
Status, error state-change semantics, and minimum safe recovery are explicit on the common packet rather than inferred from tool-specific data.
Every public anchor conforms to the same complete anchor-vector schema and digest rather than a transport-specific partial object.
